name: Discord
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Posts to a Discord channel through a webhook: announce going live and going offline automatically, and post any message from a workflow.

settings.label: Discord webhook URL
settings.description: In Discord: Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook, pick the channel, then Copy Webhook URL and paste it here.

settings.label: Announce when you go live
settings.description: Post in Discord every time your stream starts.

settings.label: Go-live message
settings.description: What to post when you go live. {channel} becomes your channel name and {link} a link to your stream.
settings.defaultValue: {channel} is live on Twitch! Come hang out: {link}

settings.label: Ping @everyone when you go live
settings.description: Notify everyone in the server with the go-live post.

settings.label: Post when the stream ends
settings.description: Post a thank-you in Discord when your stream goes offline.

settings.label: End-of-stream message
settings.description: What to post when the stream ends. {channel} and {link} work here too.
settings.defaultValue: {channel} just wrapped up the stream. Thanks to everyone who came by!

settings.label: Stream link
settings.description: Optional. The link used for {link}. Leave blank to link to your Twitch channel.

actions.name: Post to Discord
actions.description: Post a message, with an optional embed card, to the Discord channel your webhook points at. The step fails, with the reason, when Discord refuses it.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: The text to post. Leave blank to post only the embed.

schema.label: Ping
schema.description: Other mentions in the text never ping, so text from chat can't notify your whole server.

schema.label: Embed title
schema.description: Adds a card under the message. Leave the title and description blank for no card.

schema.label: Embed link
schema.description: Makes the card title a link.

fields.description: True once Discord accepted the message.
Discord's id for the posted message.

actions.name: Announce go-live on Discord
actions.description: Post the go-live message from the module settings. Does nothing when go-live announcements are turned off.

schema.label: Channel name
schema.description: Leave blank to use the channel that just went live.

fields.description: True when announcements are turned off and nothing was posted.

actions.name: Announce stream end on Discord
actions.description: Post the end-of-stream message from the module settings. Does nothing when end-of-stream posts are turned off.

schema.label: Channel name
schema.description: Leave blank to use the channel that just went offline.

fields.description: True when end-of-stream posts are turned off and nothing was posted.

workflows.name: Post on Discord when the stream ends
